<title level="1" right="Spell 4" pfs="Standard">
[Honeyed Words](/Spells.aspx?ID=1558)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Mental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=106" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 335

**Tradition**
[Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Dhalavei](/Deities.aspx?ID=189), [Grandmother Spider](/Deities.aspx?ID=37), [Ydajisk](/Deities.aspx?ID=148)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 10 minutes
</row>

</column>

---

Falsehoods pass your lips as smoothly as silk. You gain a +4 status bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) and against Perception checks to discern if you are telling the truth, and you add your level even if untrained. If the implausibility of your lies prompts a circumstance penalty or a DC increase, reduce that penalty by half or increase it by half.
